# Malik Adesiyan

Personal portfolio site for Malik Adesiyan, an Operations & Property
Management Virtual Assistant supporting UK, US and Canada landlords and Airbnb
hosts.

## Pages

- / (index.html): overview, about, links to the two work areas below, tools used, a client review, and contact details.
- /ops.html: Operations & Property Management work, scope and sample projects.
- /va.html: Virtual Assistant work, scope and sample projects.
- /reviews.html: client feedback.
